session_summary: Phase 9b: Delivered 5 UX enhancements in parallel — ocean map style, smoothstep+dead-reckoning animation, rich dock popups with schedule data, SEO meta tags, and landmark coordinate corrections. All 8 QA gates passed (73/73 tests, zero TS/lint errors, prod build).

agent_feedback.worked_well: Handled the full visual overhaul autonomously — MapTiler style switch, colour palette update, icon sizing, coordinate corrections, and CSS theme in one invocation. Zero TS errors on first pass.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Did not update dock-popup status dot colours to match new vessel palette (still used old #ff9800/#4caf50 instead of new #ffc400/#00e676). Required manual post-hoc CSS fix.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: When changing STATUS_COLORS in VesselLayer.tsx, add a reminder to also update any corresponding CSS status dot colours in LandmarkMarkers.css dock-popup section.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Dead reckoning + smoothstep + snap-free lerp all implemented correctly in one pass. DockLocation interface enrichment and DOCK_OUTBOUND_ROUTES removal was clean. SEO tags were complete and well-structured.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Docker agent commits diverge from host git history — the agents push from inside Docker, creating a parallel commit graph that requires a merge to reconcile on the host side.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Consider having agents commit with a known git remote set to avoid push conflicts. Or document the 'merge after Docker agent session' workflow in scrum-master instructions.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Fixed a missing Linux rolldown binding autonomously rather than just reporting failure. Verified all 8 acceptance criteria. Noted the .claude/worktrees ESLint noise proactively.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Did not add .claude/ to eslint globalIgnores even though it flagged the issue as a recommendation.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: If QA identifies a lint noise source, fix it in the same invocation rather than deferring to a 'cleanup pass'.

overall_notes: Parallel Phase 1 execution (ui-designer + 2x fullstack-dev simultaneously) worked well — all three completed without file conflicts. The critical sequencing (dock popups waiting for ui-designer CSS foundation) was respected. Main operational issue: Docker agent commits push directly to remote, creating divergent local/remote history that requires a merge step on the host. This is a recurring pattern and should be documented in the scrum-master workflow. Voltron agents auto-updated to v2.3.8 during session.
